specification.objective: Refresh only the mobile navigation golden baselines so they represent the already-implemented right-anchored page badge, using the canonical Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 artifacts from CI.

requirements.statement: The mobile-light and mobile-dark canonical PNGs match the actual images generated by the canonical Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 visual-golden job for the right-anchored page badge implementation.
Document the source CI run, tested commit, canonical runtime, image review, and SHA-256 values for all four committed canonical snapshots.
The canonical visual-golden suite passes with the refreshed mobile snapshots, while desktop baselines remain unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The two mobile PNGs are byte-for-byte the actual mobile-light and mobile-dark test images from canonical-golden CI run 40879439641 at commit cd385fabd2e0a17a3a4c3d0a68f21e240cf21161.

The README records the new mobile snapshot provenance and SHA-256 hashes, preserves the desktop snapshot hashes, and states that canonical snapshots must be generated only on Ubuntu with Flutter 3.47.2.
The full canonical-golden suite passes on the pinned Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 CI job and the desktop PNG files have no diff.

invariants.statement: Do not change application source, UI behavior, canonical test definitions, desktop snapshots, fonts, or test dependencies.
Keep all four canonical visual cases and their existing viewport, palette, and open-drawer/persistent-panel states.

forbidden_states.statement: Regenerating any canonical baseline on macOS or Windows, or accepting a screenshot that does not come from the canonical Linux runner.
Refreshing desktop images or changing application/test implementation as part of this test-baseline-only correction.

inputs.statement: The current right-anchored mobile page badge implementation and canonical failure artifacts uploaded by CI run 40879439641.
The existing desktop/mobile canonical PNGs and validation README.

outputs.statement: Refreshed mobile-only canonical screenshots and reproducible provenance documentation.

failure_semantics.statement: Any mobile canonical-golden mismatch, desktop snapshot change, provenance/hash mismatch, or screenshot not produced by the pinned Ubuntu Flutter 3.47.2 runner fails validation.
